subtopics.title: Ohm's Law and the Conductors That Break It

questions.question: Ohm's law holds — current directly proportional to potential difference — only while:
options: The temperature of the conductor remains constant

questions.question: A resistor carries 2 A when 18 V is placed across it. Its resistance is:
The current-versus-voltage graph of an ohmic conductor at constant temperature is:
options: A straight line through the origin
A curve that flattens at high voltage

questions.question: An incandescent bulb's filament is non-ohmic because:
options: It carries no current when cold
Its length shrinks as it glows
It only works on alternating current
Its temperature rises with current, its resistance climbs, and current stops growing in proportion to voltage

subtopics.title: Resistors in Series and in Parallel

questions.question: A 6 Ω and a 12 Ω resistor connected in SERIES give a total resistance of:
The same 6 Ω and 12 Ω connected in PARALLEL give:
Resistors of 12 Ω, 6 Ω and 4 Ω in parallel have a combined resistance of:
Which quantity is the same for all resistors connected in SERIES?

subtopics.title: Solving a Mixed Network Step by Step

questions.question: A 24 V battery feeds a 4 Ω resistor in series with a parallel pair of 6 Ω and 12 Ω. The total resistance is:
In that circuit, the total current delivered by the battery is:
The potential difference across the parallel pair is:
options: 12 V — the battery's 24 V minus the 12 V across the series resistor

questions.question: The 12 V across the pair splits the 3 A so that:
options: The 6 Ω carries 1 A and the 12 Ω carries 2 A
The 6 Ω carries 2 A and the 12 Ω carries 1 A — the smaller resistance takes the larger share

subtopics.title: Power, Energy and the Price of Electricity

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a correct formula for electrical power?
A battery delivers 3 A at 24 V. Its power output is:
The kilowatt-hour is a unit of:
A 2 kW kettle boils for a total of 15 minutes at a tariff of R3,00 per kWh. The cost is:
In the traffic picture, wiring a resistor in series is like:
options: Opening a new street between the intersections
Planting another checkpoint on the only road, slowing every vehicle

questions.question: Adding a resistor in PARALLEL lowers the total resistance because:
options: The new resistor uses up the voltage
The new resistor blocks the old branch
Every new branch is another open street, so more total current can flow

questions.question: Household wiring is parallel so that:
options: Every appliance gets the full supply voltage and can switch off without cutting the others
The total resistance stays as large as possible
All appliances share one current equally

subtopics.title: Walking Through the Circuit Like a Marker

questions.question: The four moves for a mixed circuit, in the correct order, are:
options: Split the amps, total current, shrink, spend the volts
Shrink the network, find total current, spend the volts, split the amps
Spend the volts, split the amps, shrink, total current
Total current, spend the volts, shrink, split

questions.question: The volts remaining after the series resistor takes its share appear across:
options: Only the branch with the larger resistance

questions.question: The closing audit of the four-move walk confirms that:
options: The branch currents add up to the current that arrived at the junction
Every resistor converts the same power
The resistances add up to the battery voltage
Each branch carries the same current

questions.question: Of two parallel branches, the branch with the SMALLER resistance carries:
options: The same current as the other branch

subtopics.title: Reading the Bill Like a Physicist

questions.question: One kilowatt-hour is the energy converted by:
options: A 1 W appliance running for one hour
A 1 kW appliance running for one hour
Any appliance running for one hour
A 1 kW appliance running for one minute

questions.question: A 3 kW geyser heating for a total of 5 hours a day uses, per day:
The difference between watts and kilowatt-hours is that:
options: Watts measure how fast energy is used; kilowatt-hours measure how much was used
They are identical quantities in different sizes
Watts measure energy and kilowatt-hours measure power
Watts apply only to heating appliances

questions.question: The most effective way to shrink a household electricity account is to:
options: Cut the hours and heat losses of high-power appliances like the geyser
Switch lights on and off repeatedly
